title: JEWISH COOKBOOK SOCIAL CLUB: A Fistful of Lentils Talk & Potluck
content_html: Join me for a talk about my cookbook "A Fistful of Lentils: Syrian-Jewish Recipes from Grandma Fritzie's Kitchen" while noshing on dishes made from the cookbook by attendees!

title: PASSOVER DEMO AND LUNCH: Congregation Adath Jeshurun
content_html: Join me for a Passover Greek spanakopita demo from my cookbook "Too Good To Passover" to celebrate the upcoming holiday! A light Mediterranean lunch will also be served.

title: MATZAH DECORATING Workshop for Kids! (in-person; grades K-5)
